description:
POSTERS 2026 continues my ongoing series of self initiated poster work, exploring a mix of detailed illustration, bold typography, automotive culture and more experimental visual ideas.

This collection moves between styles quite freely, from highly detailed natural subjects like the bumblebee artwork through to clean automotive inspired layouts and more abstract, texture driven concepts. Each piece gave me the chance to experiment with composition, lighting, colour and visual storytelling in different ways.

These posters are a creative outlet where I can test ideas, refine techniques, and push my design style further outside of client work. Some designs lean nostalgic and graphic, while others focus more on atmosphere, detail and mood, helping me build a broader and more versatile visual range throughout 2026.

POSTERS 2025 is a growing collection of self initiated poster designs exploring a wide range of themes, styles and visual ideas.

Across the series, I’ve experimented with typography, illustration, photography, colour, lighting and composition, creating everything from nostalgic ’90s inspired pieces and sneaker artwork to floral studies, automotive posters and playful pop culture tributes.

These projects give me space to explore different creative directions, refine my style, and experiment with new techniques outside of client work. Some pieces are bold and graphic, others are softer and more detailed, but they all come from a genuine love of design and making things that feel visually interesting and fun.

The collection continues to evolve over time, with each poster acting as a small creative experiment and a snapshot of ideas I’ve wanted to explore throughout 2025.

Ghost Guys is a fictional brand that blends humour with a slightly eerie edge, built around a cast of rubber hose-style ghost characters. The concept plays in that space between playful and mysterious, giving the brand a unique and memorable personality.

This project explores a full visual identity system, extending across a wide range of real-world applications. From business cards and appointment cards to storefront signage and vehicle wraps, the goal was to create a cohesive brand that could exist convincingly in the real world.

I designed a variety of branded collateral and merchandise including posters, stickers, enamel pins, packaging, and a product box. Each piece helping to build out the universe of the brand and reinforce its character-driven identity.

This was a self-initiated project focused on pushing illustration and branding together, using expressive character design and bold, graphic visuals to create something that feels both fun and slightly offbeat.

Bewk Club is a fictional café brand built around the idea of community, creativity, and caffeine. It invites groups to gather over coffee and dive into their latest book club reads together.

This branding project includes a full visual identity and a suite of supporting collateral—from business cards and letterheads to signage and storefront mockups.

I also created a range of merchandise to bring the brand to life: hoodies, tees, tote bags, and bookmarks—all designed to feel cosy, modern, and bookish.

This concept was self-initiated as a way to explore brand storytelling through design, with a focus on creating a welcoming and cohesive visual experience.

Afters and Full Time Sender, a local club and gig promoter, reached out to have me design posters for their events featuring local DJs and artists. The brief gave me the opportunity to explore a style of design I don't usually work in, which made it a really fun project to take on.

The designs were created for both Afters and Return to Sender, with a focus on bold visuals and an energetic feel suited to the club scene. It was great to experiment with a different creative direction, push myself outside my usual comfort zone, and create something the team loved.

The Daily Beer Can project was a collaborative effort between myself and two friends, where we designed a unique beer can each day.

Each design featured a brand name, logo, beer name, and background, drawing inspiration from iconic pop culture movies.

Collaborating in Figma, we worked to daily deadlines, played to our strengths, and explored new design techniques.

Below are some of my favorite designs from this fun and rewarding project.

For our wedding, my partner and I collaborated on designing the invitation, welcome board, and QR code cards.

The invitation set the tone for our celebration, reflecting our personal style and the joy of the occasion.

The welcome board greeted guests upon arrival, simply directing them upstairs to the venue.

One of the highlights was the QR code cards, which I designed to encourage guests to capture and share their moments from the wedding.

The QR code allowed guests to easily upload their photos to a shared album, making it a fun and interactive way to collect memories from our special day.

This project was not only a labor of love but also a great way to showcase our creativity and teamwork as a couple.

I later built a custom website to display all those amazing memories in one place. The site features a responsive, masonry-style gallery that dynamically loads images via JSON, allowing us to showcase our guests' candid moments in a clean, engaging way. This was a great opportunity to bring together my love of design and web development into one meaningful project.
tools: CorelDraw,Photoshop, React, React Masonry CSS & JSON

description:
Tipu Garden Management is a gardening company founded by my brother-in-law, focused on providing professional and friendly gardening services.

The goal was to create a brand identity that stood out from the usual gardening aesthetics by incorporating earthy tones with a natural yet vibrant feel.

The project included designing a logo, business cards, and branded clothing such as hats and uniforms.

The final design successfully captured the essence of the brand, maintaining a professional look while staying approachable and fresh.

The logo translates beautifully into embroidery and screen printing, ensuring consistent and high-quality branding across all materials.
